scenarios.title: A｜请老师重复
scenarios.setting: 老师正在讲解作业要求，但玩家没有听清最后一句。

turns.text: For next week, read chapters three and four and answer the questions at the end of—

turns.prompt: 你想确认听到的信息，会怎样请对方重复或拼写？

choices.text: Sorry, could you repeat that last part?

feedback.naturalExpression: Sorry, could you repeat that last part?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Excuse me, I didn’t quite catch that. Could you say it again?

feedback.naturalExpression: Excuse me, I didn’t quite catch that. Could you say it again?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Sorry, did you say chapters three and four?

feedback.naturalExpression: Sorry, did you say chapters three and four?
feedback.explanation: 先说明是在核对理解，再复述关键信息，便于对方纠正听错或记错的细节。

choices.text: Could you go over the assignment one more time?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you go over the assignment one more time?
feedback.explanation: “assignment”指布置的任务，是可数名词。

choices.text: Teacher, please say again.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Sorry, could you repeat that last part?
feedback.explanation: 英文通常按姓名或头衔称呼老师，不直接喊“Teacher”；重说需有宾语，如“Could you say that again?”。

turns.text: Sure. Read chapters three and four and answer the questions at the end of each chapter.

turns.prompt: 你想核实自己对刚才信息的理解，会怎么问？

choices.text: So we need to answer the questions for both chapters?

feedback.naturalExpression: So we need to answer the questions for both chapters?
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

choices.text: Got it. Do we need to submit the answers online?

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it. Do we need to submit the answers online?
feedback.explanation: “Do we need”问的是有没有必要或是否必须，帮助分清必做步骤与可选做法。

choices.text: And is this due next week?

feedback.naturalExpression: And is this due next week?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

turns.text: Yes. Upload your answers before next Tuesday’s class.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay, thank you. That’s clear now.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, thank you. That’s clear now.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: Got it. Thanks for repeating that.

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it. Thanks for repeating that.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

scenarios.title: B｜询问某个词
scenarios.setting: 老师在课堂上使用了一个玩家不认识的词。

turns.text: This is a good example of something being “ambiguous.”

turns.prompt: 你想请老师解释不认识的词，会怎么说？

choices.text: Excuse me, what does “ambiguous” mean?

feedback.naturalExpression: Excuse me, what does “ambiguous” mean?
feedback.explanation: 直接指出没理解的词或说法，让对方解释该部分，而不必重讲全部内容。

choices.text: Sorry, could you explain what “ambiguous” means?

feedback.naturalExpression: Sorry, could you explain what “ambiguous” means?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: I’m not familiar with that word. What does it mean here?

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not familiar with that word. What does it mean here?
feedback.explanation: 直接指出没理解的词或说法，让对方解释该部分，而不必重讲全部内容。

choices.text: Could you give us an example of “ambiguous”?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you give us an example of “ambiguous”?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: What’s the meaning about “ambiguous”?

feedback.naturalExpression: Excuse me, what does “ambiguous” mean?
feedback.explanation: 问词义用“the meaning of”，不是“the meaning about”；也可问“What does … mean?”。

turns.text: It means something can be understood in more than one way, or its meaning isn’t completely clear.

turns.prompt: 你想核实自己对刚才信息的理解，会怎么问？

choices.text: So it means there could be more than one interpretation?

feedback.naturalExpression: So it means there could be more than one interpretation?
feedback.explanation: 把需要的行动明确说出来，并用礼貌用语缓和请求；对方能直接回应能否做到。

choices.text: Would something with two possible meanings be ambiguous?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would something with two possible meanings be ambiguous?
feedback.explanation: 先确认后续安排能否实现，便于对方说明条件、时间或限制。

choices.text: Could you use it in another sentence?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you use it in another sentence?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

turns.text: Sure. If I say, “I saw the man with the telescope,” it’s ambiguous because it’s not clear who has the telescope.

turns.prompt: 你想表示理解对方的解释或立场，会怎么说？

choices.text: Oh, I see what you mean now.

feedback.naturalExpression: Oh, I see what you mean now.
feedback.explanation: 直接指出没理解的词或说法，让对方解释该部分，而不必重讲全部内容。

choices.text: That makes sense. Thanks.

feedback.naturalExpression: That makes sense. Thanks.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

scenarios.title: C｜课后再次询问
scenarios.setting: 课堂上玩家大概听懂了，但课后发现自己仍然不确定。

turns.text: Professor Miller, do you have a minute? I have a question about what we discussed today.
Sure. What are you having trouble with?

turns.prompt: 关于「没听懂课堂内容」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: I’m still a little confused about the difference between these two concepts.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m still a little confused about the difference between these two concepts.
feedback.explanation: “confused”指困惑的，适合承认尚未理解。

choices.text: I thought I understood it in class, but I’m not completely sure.

feedback.naturalExpression: I thought I understood it in class, but I’m not completely sure.
feedback.explanation: “I thought”说明自己原先的理解，适合在信息不一致时提出核对。

choices.text: Could you explain this part one more time?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you explain this part one more time?
feedback.explanation: “more / extra / another”表示在已有数量上增加，能说明是补充需求。

choices.text: I understand the basic idea, but I’m having trouble applying it.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand the basic idea, but I’m having trouble applying it.
feedback.explanation: “I understand”承认听懂了对方的理由或难处，为继续协商提供基础。

choices.text: I still don’t understand anything you taught today.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I’m still a little confused about the difference between these two concepts.
feedback.explanation: “anything … today”范围太大，老师难以定位；指出哪一段或哪个概念没懂，更容易解释。

turns.prompt: 你想表示理解对方的解释或立场，会怎么说？

choices.text: I understand the definition, but I’m not sure when I’m supposed to use it.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand the definition, but I’m not sure when I’m supposed to use it.
feedback.explanation: “supposed to”表示按原计划、约定或要求应该如此，可以用来对照实际情况。

choices.text: I’m having trouble seeing the difference between the two examples.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m having trouble seeing the difference between the two examples.
feedback.explanation: 说明正在尝试的动作或遇到的困难，帮助对方针对卡住的环节提供协助。

choices.text: This example makes sense, but I’m confused about the second one.

feedback.naturalExpression: This example makes sense, but I’m confused about the second one.
feedback.explanation: “confused”指困惑的，适合承认尚未理解。

choices.text: Could we go through this example together?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could we go through this example together?
feedback.explanation: “Could I / we …?”礼貌提出自己的需求或征求许可；这里不是在说过去的能力。

turns.text: Sure. Let’s look at the second example again.

turns.prompt: 你想核实自己对刚才信息的理解，会怎么问？

choices.text: Okay. So in this case, why do we use this one instead of the other one?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. So in this case, why do we use this one instead of the other one?
feedback.explanation: “instead of”引出想替换掉的选项，让对方清楚比较的是哪两个方案。

choices.text: Is it because the meaning changes in this situation?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is it because the meaning changes in this situation?
feedback.explanation: 补充原因或目的，让对方明白提出这个想法的依据。

choices.text: Ah, I think I see the difference now. Let me make sure I’ve got it right.

feedback.naturalExpression: Ah, I think I see the difference now. Let me make sure I’ve got it right.
feedback.explanation: “make sure”表示核实、确认，能说明重复提问是为避免理解出错。

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: That makes much more sense now. Thank you.

feedback.naturalExpression: That makes much more sense now. Thank you.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: Got it. Thanks for taking the time to explain it again.

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it. Thanks for taking the time to explain it again.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。
